Added an explicit set_empty marker to LifecycleToolBeforeResult. A tool_before hook sets set_empty:true to wipe the arguments to the empty string, distinct from 'no change' (empty arguments, no marker); a non-empty arguments still rewrites. The wipe flows through the agent-side JSON validation, so a wiped call fails closed unless '' is valid for the tool — distinct from suppress, which kills the call pre-execution.
